summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem has become the de facto open standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data, and services via structured JSON-RPC interfaces. As of 2026, adoption spans aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of integrations, gateways that secure and proxy MCP traffic, and individual servers maintained by vendors like Microsoft, GitHub, and Figma. This matters because MCP lets AI agents reliably query databases, automate browsers, manage deployments, and triage issues without bespoke per-tool integrations.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (Composio, Smithery, mcp.so) expose many tools through one managed endpoint, gateways (agentgateway, Cloudflare, Kong) add auth, routing, and security in front of MCP servers, and individual servers (Playwright, GitHub, Figma) each connect an agent to a single specific tool or service.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation — exposes 25+ tools for navigation, clicking, form-filling, and test generation via accessibility tree snapshots (no vision models required)
strengths: Ranked the most-used MCP server in the community in mid-2026
No vision models or screenshot processing needed
Runs in CI/CD (GitHub Actions) for AI-driven browser testing
tools.best_for: AI agents that write and run browser tests or automate web workflows

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, and code search via an OAuth-secured remote MCP endpoint
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; usage tied to GitHub account tiers
strengths: Official OAuth-secured remote server from GitHub
Core to agent coding workflows across Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex
Deep repo, issue, and PR automation
Works in CI environments without local credential leakage
tools.best_for: AI agents managing code, issues, and pull requests on GitHub

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ tools (Slack, GitHub, Gmail, databases) through a managed MCP layer with auth, retries, and a self-learning tool-selection layer
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based paid tiers for higher volume and enterprise features
strengths: 1B+ tool calls run on the platform
Self-learning layer improves tool selection and token efficiency (30% more accurate on 2x fewer tokens for repeat tasks)
Managed auth across many SaaS integrations
tools.best_for: Building production AI agents that span many SaaS tools with managed auth

tools.name: Context7
tools.connects_to: Up-to-date library and framework documentation injected directly into an agent's context window
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; paid Upstash plans for higher usage
strengths: Consistently a top pick across Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex in 2026
Eliminates outdated-docs hallucinations in code generation
tools.best_for: Giving coding agents current, version-accurate documentation

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: A registry and hosting platform for thousands of MCP servers with one-click install and remote hosting
tools.best_for: Discovering, installing, and hosting MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Figma MCP
tools.connects_to: Figma design files — reads frames, components, and design tokens so agents can generate code from designs
tools.pricing_paid: Free server; requires a Figma account (paid Figma plans for team features)
strengths: Official OAuth-secured remote MCP from Figma
tools.best_for: Converting Figma designs into code via AI agents

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Hosts and secures remote MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers with OAuth, routing, and edge deployment
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans for higher usage and features
strengths: Managed remote MCP hosting at the edge
First-class remote MCP tooling and templates
tools.best_for: Deploying secure, scalable remote MCP servers in production

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: A community directory indexing thousands of MCP servers for discovery and comparison
strengths: One of the most-visited MCP discovery directories
tools.best_for: Browsing and discovering available MCP servers

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.connects_to: Supabase Postgres databases, auth, and storage — lets agents query, migrate, and manage projects
tools.pricing_paid: Free server; Supabase paid plans for larger databases
strengths: Direct database querying and schema management for agents
Popular across the AI-app developer community
tools.best_for: AI agents querying and managing Postgres/Supabase backends

tools.name: n8n MCP
tools.connects_to: n8n workflow automation — lets agents trigger and build workflows across 400+ integrated apps
tools.pricing_paid: Free self-hosted (fair-code); n8n Cloud paid tiers
strengths: Bridges MCP agents to n8n's large automation ecosystem
Connects to hundreds of downstream apps
tools.best_for: Agents orchestrating multi-step automation across many apps

tools.name: agentgateway
tools.connects_to: Proxies and secures MCP and A2A traffic with auth, observability, multiplexing, and policy enforcement in front of many servers
tools.best_for: Enterprises centralizing security and routing for many MCP servers

tools.name: Docker MCP
tools.connects_to: Docker containers and the Docker MCP Catalog/Toolkit — run MCP servers in isolated containers and manage images/containers
tools.pricing_paid: Free; Docker paid subscriptions for team/enterprise features
strengths: Sandboxed, secure MCP server execution in containers
Official Docker MCP Catalog with curated servers
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers securely in isolated containers
